elements.name: SIT-TC-STD-CONFIG-001 Verify that an admin user can open the session batch operation menu after selecting sessions

steps.name: I am logged in to the real Standard Product admin UI
I open the no-seat session management UI with session rows
I open the session batch operation menu
the batch operation menu shows the three signed actions
no batch write API is emitted by the UI flow

elements.name: SIT-TC-STD-CONFIG-012 Verify that pre-generation is blocked when a required target value is missing

steps.name: I am logged in to the real Standard Product admin UI
I open the no-seat session management UI with session rows
I open saleable-ticket-group batch modification without selecting a target group
the UI blocks pre-generation because the target group is required
no batch write API is emitted by the UI flow

elements.name: SIT-TC-STD-CONFIG-014 Verify that canceling or closing the preview does not save changes

I generate a session-list-display preview and close without confirming
